result.reasoning: This commit ("Grid image issue resolved") removed the direct `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` call that used to follow the `findViewById(R.id.gridView)` line, moving adapter-setting logic to only occur inside a runOnUiThread callback within the getMovies() network-fetch flow. This means when `updateUI()` takes the "movies already loaded" branch (calling resetImageAdapter() instead of getMovies()), gridview never gets an adapter assigned, leaving it blank. The fix commit 550830f34ace restores the missing `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` call right after `findViewById`, directly undoing the omission introduced in 31540ff5f397.
